token.label: API Key
token.description:
To generate your API key:

1. Log in to [studio.vidlab7.com](https://studio.vidlab7.com/)
2. Click on **API** in the bottom section of the left-hand menu
3. Click the **Generate new key** button at the top right
4. Give your key a descriptive name and click **Generate**
5. Copy and store the key securely (you'll only see it once)

createVideo.label: Create Video

avatarId.label: Avatar ID
avatarId.description: The ID of the avatar to be used for the video generation

script.label: Script
script.description: The script to be used for the video generation

voiceId.description: The ID of the voice to be used for the video generation

webhookUrl.label: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: The URL to which the webhook will be sent when video generation is complete

use_speaker_boost.label: Use Speaker Boost
use_speaker_boost.description: Enable speaker boost for better voice quality

waitForCompletion.label: Wait for Completion
waitForCompletion.description: Wait for the video generation to complete and return the video URL. If disabled, only returns the video ID.
